Great for jazz or just a few drinks
Sep 2024 • Couples
We were staying in the hotel and had already booked dinner at Kumihimo so we stopped in for some pre-dinner cocktails. It was very quiet at 1800 but ramped up when we came back around 2100 (live music doesn't start until around 2030). We had a great chat about Vietnam, history and cocktails with Q&A (Quang Anh (sp?)) at the bar. I went with basic whisky but my wife loved the cocktail, made with Vietnamese flavours. 

The ambience is very funky - jazz club as you might expect. Lot's of hats, instruments, old radios etc. The live music was amazing. I am no jazz fan, but these guys are incredible. All took turns at solos but the pianist was incredible. You could hardly see his hands moving. Amazing stuff.

This is a great place to listen to some cool music and to relax. Give it a go. It's a bit expensive but worth it.

Insider tip:
You may need to book, it fills up pretty quick some nights.
